actors.name: Veldt Solar executive team
actors.private_context: The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will decide at the quarterly review whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to the utility-scale line; the CEO has stayed publicly neutral. They are aware of the pilot's 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

actors.name: Pilot team
actors.private_context: The pilot team is awaiting the executive team's decision on the balcony-panel pilot. They are not part of the decision-making process.

shared_context: Veldt Solar's quarterly review is scheduled for the week of 2026-10-05. The executive team will meet to decide on the balcony-panel pilot. The pilot sold 400 units against a 1,000-unit target with strong reviews but thin margins. The head of product champions it, the CFO wants those engineers on the utility-scale line, and the CEO has stayed publicly neutral. The decision (shelve or greenlight) will be communicated to the pilot team the same week as the review.

starting_events.description: The quarterly review begins. The executive team is scheduled to discuss and decide on the balcony-panel pilot.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally decided to greenlight the pilot and communicated that decision to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Resolve NO if the executive team formally decided to shelve the pilot and communicated that decision to the pilot team before the cutoff, or if no decision is communicated by the cutoff.
